name: Dairy-based infant desserts (yogurt, fromage frais, custard, pudding)

tHg.label: government read-across — Israel FCS-2016 porridges & other foods for infants and toddlers, total-Hg 8 (the strictest applicable baby-food mercury ML; stricter than the dairy-specific IL/HK milk total-Hg 10).
tHg.basis_note: face value (nearest government value; comparator vs any direct limit)

Cr.label: government read-across — China GB 2762 liquid-milk total-Cr 300 (scope: raw, pasteurized, sterilized, modified and fermented milk) applied at face value to a wet dairy infant dessert (basis-matched dairy analogy). Chromium IS material in a dairy matrix, so a not-material determination is not used; total Cr is a published ceiling and Cr(VI) is additionally controlled by reflex speciation (any total-Cr > 100 ppb triggers Cr(VI) speciation; any quantifiable Cr(VI) fails).
Cr.basis_note: face value (nearest government value; comparator vs any direct limit)

Sn.label: government read-across (India FSSAI "Infant Milk substitute and Infant foods" Sn 5000, the only non-canned tin ML in the register) applied at face value.
Sn.basis_note: face value (nearest government value; comparator vs any direct limit)

Al.label: government read-across (AU-NZ Schedule 19 infant-formula Al 500, the only government aluminium ML in any jurisdiction) applied at face value; the 8:1 reconstitution factor is formula-specific and is not applied to a non-formula product.
Al.basis_note: face value (nearest government value; comparator vs any direct limit)

method: HMTc Method v2.0 (government-limit default, 8:1 basis, read-across)
